responsibilities: Verified provider profile and exact model ID
Wire schema adaptation without weakening local contract
Rate limits, token budget, classified retries, timeout and circuit breaker
Exact tool allowlist and input schema
Authenticated principal, role, scope, current authorization and state checks
Stable command IDs and output schema/projection validation

components.name: web_business_api
components.owns: Trusted UI, authentication, domain commands and scoped views

components.name: agent_worker
components.owns: Bounded model activities; no PSP secret or direct ledger writer

components.name: transaction_worker
components.owns: Payment submit/query/reconcile, refunds, outbox; no open-ended model code

components.name: postgresql
components.owns: Authoritative state, budget, job checkpoints, inbox/outbox

components.name: object_store
components.owns: Private evidence objects and scoped temporary downloads

components.name: secret_manager
components.owns: Provider credentials separately granted per process

consistency: At-least-once notification plus deduplication, stable operation keys, transactional budget and explicit reconciliation; no end-to-end exactly-once claim
migration: Provider swap changes model profile, request/response adapter, wire schema and evaluation baseline; domain money/authorization contracts remain provider-neutral
region: Record actual model, payment and storage data paths; Hong Kong users do not imply Hong Kong-only data residency.
